messages:
Ana (Product): Quick idea — build a "telemetry explorer" inside Console that focuses on per-route + per-model breakdowns. Saved views that teams can share (and pin) for on-call, SRE, product. Thoughts?
Mike (Eng): I like. Needs filters: model, route, timeframe, env (prod/canary), and ability to bucket by hour/day.
Zara (Design): Also we should let people choose columns: p50/p95, error rate, tokens in/out, cost per 1k tokens, throughput (rps). Keep default minimal.
Priya (Security): Saved view scope is important — org-wide vs team vs user. Org-wide needs audit logs and an approval flow. I vote team-default, org opt-in.
Sam (Eng Platform): API question: should saved views be backend objects (id + filter blob) so we can share links and enforce perms, or just frontend presets? Backend gives shareability + perm checks.
Mike (Eng): Backend objects make sense but we need a permission API. Also consider Private deployments — customers might want to restrict sharing across projects.
devx-bot: Note: analytics raw event retention = 90d, aggregated metrics retention = 13 months. Sampling currently 1% for routes > 5000 rps.
Ana (Product): UI ideas: top quick-filters, then an "advanced" JSON query editor for power users. Export CSV and scheduled email reports.
Zara (Design): Add a small action on a saved view: "Create rollout guard" — ties a saved view (e.g., p95 < X) to a canary rollout rule.
Priya (Security): For high-volume routes we should enforce sampling when a saved-view would otherwise hit too much raw data. Also need role scoping for who can create org-wide views.
Mike (Eng): Internal API debate: do we store route by `route_id` (immutable) or `route_name` (human friendly)? route_name can change with renames.
Sam (Eng Platform): Store both in the saved object: canonical `route_id` for lookups + `route_name` for display. That avoids drift and keeps UI readable.
Ana (Product): Good call. Action items: Sam -> draft saved-view schema; Priya -> permission model + audit requirements; Zara -> UI mockups for quick filters & advanced editor. Can we aim for a prototype by end of week?
Sam (Eng Platform): I'll draft schema and post it in #eng-platform by Thu. Schema will include id, owner, scope, filter_blob, columns, pinned boolean, created_at.
Priya (Security): I'll prepare a short RFC for permission granularity (user/team/org) and audit events needed.
Zara (Design): I'll produce two mock screens: quick presets panel + advanced JSON editor. Will link Figma by Fri.
Ana (Product): Who owns migration from existing "presets" and saved filters?
Mike (Eng): I'll own migration mapping old presets -> new saved-view objects. Need a small script and a rollout plan to avoid messing with live dashboards.
devx-bot: deploy-bot: analytics-ui/v1 deployed to staging at 1718004500 :rocket:
Zara (Design): Nice — I'll validate CSV export and the rollout hook tomorrow.
Ana (Product): Sweet. We'll sync Thurs standup if any blockers. :thumbsup:
